title: Restore editable Callaway chart (revert backend-managed chart lock)

requirements.text: Re-enable the Admin Callaway chart editor UI so that when Admin Access is enabled, the /admin page shows the editable chart interface instead of a locked “backend-managed chart” message.

quotes: return the app to the last version that allows editing the chart

acceptanceCriteria: With Admin Access disabled, /admin continues to show the existing "Admin Access Disabled" card and Settings navigation.

With Admin Access enabled, /admin renders the CallawayChartEditor (18-hole and 9-hole tabs, editable grid, Save Changes, Reset to Defaults) and does not show messaging that chart editing is moved to the backend.
All user-facing text on the /admin page is in English.

requirements.text: Restore chart editing functionality end-to-end by making the scoring calculations and chart display use the locally editable Callaway chart (from the localStorage-backed chart persistence layer) so user edits affect results.

quotes: return the app to the last version that allows editing the chart

acceptanceCriteria: Editing chart values in the CallawayChartEditor and clicking "Save Changes" changes the chart used by the app when calculating results in LeaderboardView.
LeaderboardView no longer blocks results rendering solely due to failure to load the backend chart; it can calculate and display results using the locally editable chart.
The chart shown in the leaderboard "Callaway Scoring Chart" section reflects the same chart data being used for calculations (including any saved edits).

requirements.text: Ensure the app no longer presents the Callaway chart as backend-locked/centrally managed, and remove any UI copy that implies chart edits require contacting a system administrator.

quotes: return the app to the last version that allows editing the chart

acceptanceCriteria: The Admin panel no longer shows text stating "The Callaway scoring chart is now managed by the backend system" or similar locked/centralized-management messaging.
The app’s Settings description for Admin Access remains accurate (admin features include the Callaway chart editor).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI component sources).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep all backend logic (if any is modified) within the single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if state migration is required.
nonGoals: Do not add multi-user or shared chart synchronization across devices.
Do not add third-party authentication or external database/storage.
Do not redesign the scoring algorithm beyond restoring chart editability impact (no new scoring modes).
